pairs=[None]*n

for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[i]=j; pairs[j]=i
seq=['A']*n

        j=pairs[i]
        if i<j:
            seq[i]='G'
            seq[j]='C'
        else:
            pass  # already set
s=''.join(seq)
print(len(s), s)
